usageNotes: Use this endpoint to preview the next N fire times for a Proxmox systemd-style calendar schedule before assigning it to a backup job, replication job, or other cluster job — it validates the schedule string and shows exactly when it will trigger. The `schedule` parameter must conform to the `pve-calendar-event` format (e.g., `daily`, `mon..fri 02:00`, `*/2:00`); invalid strings return an error rather than a result set. No special privilege is required — all authenticated users can call it.

examples.summary: Preview the next 5 fire times for a weekday 2 AM backup schedule starting from now

tips: Omit `starttime` to anchor the simulation to the current server time; supply a UNIX timestamp to model future or past schedule windows.
The maximum `iterations` value is 100 — for long-horizon planning, chain multiple calls with successive `starttime` values offset from the last returned timestamp.
Use this before saving a job to confirm that an unfamiliar schedule expression fires as often as expected — the API validates the format server-side and will error on malformed strings.
